independent_verification.nilpotent_resolvent: For λ≠0, R=Σ_(k=0)^n λ^(-k-1) T_n^k is a bounded two-sided inverse of λI−T_n by telescoping. The vector e_(n+1) is in ker(T_n), also when n=0 with e_1.
